text: 澳大利亚政府定于周四公布削减移民规模的计划，其中包括加大力度打击签证逾期滞留者，并收紧家庭团聚类签证规定。澳大利亚内政部长Tony Burke将在全国新闻俱乐部发表一场一再推迟的演讲，阐述相关改革。演讲题为《移民项目的管理工作：谁来、谁留、谁走》。新计划将重点针对通过不断转换签证类别来延长在澳居留时间的人士，以及留学生、临时工人和他们的家属。澳大利亚政府的目标是将本财年净移民人数控制在约24.5万人，这一目标是在今年5月公布的预算案中设定的。近年来，澳大利亚实际移民人数持续超过政府自身设定的目标，也因此招致政治右翼的批评。（澳大利亚金融评论报）
text_en: The Australian government is scheduled to announce a plan on Thursday to cut immigration levels, including stepping up efforts to crack down on visa overstayers and tightening rules for family reunion visas. Australian Minister for Home Affairs Tony Burke will deliver a repeatedly postponed speech at the National Press Club to explain the reforms. The speech is titled "Managing the Migration Program: Who Comes, Who Stays, Who Leaves." The new plan will focus on people who extend their stay in Australia by constantly switching visa categories, as well as international students, temporary workers and their dependents. The Australian government aims to keep net migration at about 245,000 this fiscal year, a target set in the budget announced in May this year. In recent years, Australia's actual immigration numbers have continued to exceed the government's own targets, drawing criticism from the political right. (Australian Financial Review)
